scares.description: Kerry wipes the steam off the mirror and sees Eric’s reflection.
A person wearing a pig’s mask suddenly jumps out at Lynn while she is on the phone in the locker room.
Amanda grabs Lynn and pulls her close.
Lynn reaches for a phone but a trap goes off causing her to pull back. Seconds later Amanda appears behind Lynn, startling her once more.
During a flashback, Amanda is attacked by Eric.
